proposed.sourceName: Islamic Food & Nutrition Council of America (IFANCA) — Five-Star Halal Identification System
proposed.paraphrase: IFANCA certifies only Muslim-performed slaughter (it does not accept meat slaughtered by non-Muslims) with Tasmiyah/Takbir; it accepts mechanical poultry slaughter (machine started by a Muslim reciting the Tasmiyah, with a Muslim on the line) and controlled stunning under veterinary confirmation — meeting the mainstream general-halal baseline (machine slaughter accepted).

researcherNote: IFANCA accepts mechanical slaughter + controlled stunning → correctly mapped to general/lenient only (its stricter Star-5 tier is non-stun, but the body as a whole certifies mechanical/stunned). APPROVED by owner 2026-07-01 (batch pre-approval).
